items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I kind of fall somewhere in there in the mix with Earl Garner and Oscar Peterson and Ahmad Jamal, pretty good company.

ctx.x: Okay. They‘re not going to care what I think. Really, who is this woman talking to her? We just want to hear more of her. [laughs]

Well, I don‘t know how much you know about my music, you know. I don‘t know where to put it. I kind of fall somewhere in there in the mix with Earl Garner and Oscar Peterson and Ahmad Jamal, pretty good company.

Certainly as a piano player. I mean, definitely when you listen to your music you are torn. You don‘t know what you want to listen to. I guess words appeal to me. I tell you, the best way I can describe it is that if I could find a man that loves me the way you sing about love, I would be set for life.
